sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Browser-side setup and imports
sections.what: Marks the file as browser code and brings in the session provider and the child content type.
sections.why: Likely reason: the session provider is designed to run in the browser.
sections.watch_out: Do not remove the browser marker without checking that the session still works.

sections.name: AuthProvider
sections.title: Session wrapper
sections.what: Places the child content inside the session provider and returns it.
sections.why: Likely reason: so every nearby component can read who is signed in.
sections.watch_out: Anything placed outside this wrapper cannot read the session.

summary: A small wrapper that makes the signed-in user's session available to the components inside it.
purpose: Lets parts of the app know who is signed in, using the sign-in library's session provider.
why: Likely reason: the sign-in library needs a provider around components that read the session.
how: Takes the child content and places it inside the session provider, then returns it.
inputs: The child content (children) passed in by a parent.
outputs: The same child content, now wrapped in the session provider.
risks: Components that read sign-in state show empty or wrong values if this wrapper sits below them in the tree.
debug: If a component says the visitor is signed out when they are not, confirm this wrapper is high enough in the page tree. Then check the sign-in library's session route.
